title: Starlight + starlight-polyglot Migration
summary: Migrate documentation generation from Sphinx to Astro Starlight with starlight-polyglot for Python API docs.
motivation: Replace the legacy Sphinx-based documentation pipeline with a modern, polyglot-aware Starlight site that supports auto-generated API documentation from Python source via Griffe, while preserving 41 existing MDX handbook pages.

legacy_retirement.retention: Legacy Sphinx source and build artifacts retained for archival reference until formal closure of this track.
